Report_ID: Persistent secretory otitis media defined as type C2 or type B tympanogram at day 30
Title: Autoinflation as a Treatment of Secretory Otitis Media: A Randomized Controlled Study
Author: S. E. Stangerup; J. Sederberg-Olsen; V. Balle
Comment: The paper reports day-30 results per ear, not per child. It gives separate C2 and B percentages but does not print a combined C2-or-B event count. Under the anti-hallucination rule, combined persistence events were therefore left null rather than reconstructed. Moreover, the autoinflation day-30 percentages (17.4, 6.5, 50.0, and 26.1) appear to correspond to 46 classified ears while Table 6 prints N=47, so deriving events from the printed percentages and N would be internally inconsistent. The number of children contributing these day-30 ears is not stated, so the prespecified within-child design-effect adjustment cannot be calculated. The p value was reported only as P<.05; 0.05 records the stated threshold, not an exact p value. The analysis was also described as including only children who performed autoinflation as prescribed.; unsupported or insufficient statistic type
Medium: Autoinflation using a nasal tube and balloon
Content length: Autoinflation three times daily for 2 weeks; continued for 2 additional weeks when type C2 or B persisted at 2 weeks
Topic of Content: Middle-ear autoinflation for secretory otitis media
Participant type: Children aged 3 to 10 years with unilateral or bilateral secretory otitis media for at least 3 months
Outcome type: Binary persistence construct derived from categorical tympanogram types
Outcome measurement: Tympanometry; persistence defined by the synthesis plan as type C2 or type B
Outcome variable: Persistent secretory otitis media defined as type C2 or type B tympanogram at day 30
outcome_family: persistence of otitis media with effusion by 6 weeks
effect_direction: Lower risk of persistence favours autoinflation (RR < 1).

Title: Effect of nasal balloon autoinflation in children with otitis media with effusion in primary care: an open randomized controlled trial
Author: Williamson et al.
Comment: Persistence counts were not reported directly; they were validly derived from the explicitly reported analyzed totals and resolution counts: standard care 132−47=85, autoinflation 131−62=69. The paper's adjusted RR 1.36 (95% CI 0.99–1.88) is for resolution, the opposite event, and was therefore not entered as the RR for persistence. Per-child data were used, so no ear-correlation design-effect adjustment was applied. The separate pilot study was not extracted because no pilot-specific arm-level counts are reported in the supplied text.

Title: LONG TERM EFFECT OF AUTOINFLATION IN THE TREATMENT OF OTITIS MEDIA WITH EFFUSION
Author: İbrahim Ercan; Burak Ömür Çakır; Semra Kayaoğlu; Suat Turgut
Comment: The paper reports recovery per ear rather than persistence per child. Raw persistence was derived from explicit recovery counts: autoinflation 48−27=21 of 48 ears; control 45−14=31 of 45 ears. Because bilateral ears were included, the synthesis-plan correlation adjustment was applied separately by arm using DE = 1 + (average ears per child − 1) × 0.5. Autoinflation: average 48/30=1.6 ears/child, DE=1.3, yielding adjusted 21/1.3=16.153846 events and 48/1.3=36.923077 total. Control: average 45/30=1.5, DE=1.25, yielding adjusted 31/1.25=24.8 events and 45/1.25=36 total. Title: Autoinflation in the treatment of glue ear in children
Author: D.S. Brooker & A. McNeice
Comment: The paper reports outcomes per ear, not per child, despite randomization by child. Following the synthesis contract, both arm events and totals were divided by the study-level design effect DE = 1 + (78 ears / 40 children - 1) × 0.5 = 1.475. Adjusted effective counts entered are Group A 37/1.475 events out of 41/1.475 and Group B 27/1.475 events out of 37/1.475. Raw reported counts are 37/41 versus 27/37. The Table 1 outcome combines audiogram and tympanogram improvement criteria, so 'no improvement' is an indirect proxy for persistent effusion rather than a purely tympanometric persistence definition.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Group A (autoinflation)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
